checks.name: The file is YAML
checks.about: Each file can be read, and holds a YAML mapping of fields.

checks.name: The file is of the version this release reads
checks.about: awml is "0.8". An older file is upgraded with awml convert.

checks.name: Every field is known and none is missing
checks.about: Each file, scope, part, line, implementation, block and comment has the fields it needs and no others, and each list is a list of mappings.

checks.name: Every kind is known
checks.about: Each part and line has a kind the spec defines.

checks.name: No id is used twice
checks.about: Scope, part, block and comment ids are unique across the file.

checks.name: Every id is well written
checks.about: An id is letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, and a block's platform is a company id or owner/platforms/slug.

checks.name: Every value that should be text is text
checks.about: Ids, labels, kinds and references are text, not something YAML read as true, false, a number or a date.

checks.name: Every reference names something in the file
checks.about: Each in, from and to, each part a block names and each part a comment ties names a scope, block or part the file has.

checks.name: No scope or block is nested in itself
checks.about: Following in from any scope or block never leads back to it.

checks.name: A comment is linked only by tie lines
checks.about: A comment moves nothing, so only a tie, or a hidden line, may touch it.

checks.name: Every tie has a comment at one end
checks.about: A tie links a comment to what it explains, so one of its ends is a comment.

checks.name: No line goes into a trigger
checks.about: A trigger only starts its own workflow, so no line but a tie or a hidden one goes into it. A workflow starts another with an outside action whose ref names the other's trigger.

checks.name: Every op is known and on a step
checks.about: An op is one of the operations the spec lists, on an ai, code or person step.

checks.name: Only a do step leads to an outside action
checks.about: A step that leads to an outside action, straight or through a review or a standing approval, is a do step.

checks.name: An answer or check step never writes to a context
checks.about: An answer step and a check step read contexts and speak on surfaces, but never write to a context.

checks.name: Every outside action's label ends with its tier
checks.about: An outside action's label ends with Allow, Ask or Block after a colon.

checks.name: Every tier agrees with what stands in front of it
checks.about: An Ask action has a review, a standing approval or a person's own step on every way in, an Allow action has no review or standing approval in front of it, and only red lines lead to a Block action.

checks.name: Every standing approval lists its actions on a surface
checks.about: A standing approval leads to the surface where each action it covers is listed.

checks.name: Every processing is well written
checks.about: A scope's processing is any, none, or a map from company ids to any or a list of known operations.

checks.name: An inner scope allows no more processing than its outer one
checks.about: A scope inside another allows no company or operation that the outer scope doesn't.

checks.name: Only a block takes a platform
checks.about: platform belongs to a block of an implementation, never to a scope.

checks.name: Every wait is a duration on a trigger
checks.about: wait is an ISO 8601 duration in weeks, days, hours, minutes or seconds, given only on a trigger.

checks.name: Every at is a path on a context
checks.about: at is a relative path of plain names, given only on a context.

checks.name: Only a trigger, connector or context is marked untrusted
checks.about: untrusted is true or false, and is true only on a trigger, connector or context.

checks.name: Only a code step cleans
checks.about: cleans is true or false, and is true only on a code step, since strangers' text can steer an AI step however it's written.

checks.name: No untrusted text reaches an outside action unstopped
checks.about: Text from a part marked untrusted reaches an outside action only past a review, a person's own step or a code step marked cleans, which stops it, or through a standing approval in front of the action, which accepts the risk. Workflows given together are followed through the parts they share and the workflows they start.

checks.name: Every ref is well written
checks.about: A ref is owner/slug#id for a published workflow, or a path to a file alongside, ending .yaml, then # and the part's id.

checks.name: Only a context, connector, surface or outside action takes a ref
checks.about: Workflows share the contexts, connectors and surfaces both reach, and an outside action names the trigger of the workflow it starts. A trigger belongs to the workflow it starts, so it never refers.

checks.name: No part is placed twice in an implementation
checks.about: Each part sits in at most one block of each implementation.

checks.name: Every part that needs a block has one
checks.about: Every part but a trigger or comment sits in a block of each implementation.

checks.name: Every ref names a part of the workflow it refers to
checks.about: A ref to a workflow given with it names a part that workflow has. A ref to a workflow not given is left alone.

checks.name: Every copy agrees with the part it refers to
checks.about: A context, connector or surface that refers to another workflow's has the same kind, label and at, and a scope with the same people and terms.

checks.name: Every outside action's ref names a trigger
checks.about: An outside action that refers to a workflow given with it names that workflow's trigger, which it starts.

checks.name: Every shared part has one owner
checks.about: A ref names a part of another workflow, never its own, and following refs from any copy ends at the one that owns the part, rather than going round in a circle.

checks.name: No do step is decided by AI
checks.about: A do step should be code acting on what an earlier step decided; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: Each do step makes one change
checks.about: A do step should lead to one change, counting each outside action and surface and all contexts together as one; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: The file holds one workflow
checks.about: A trigger's run is every part its start lines reach, and triggers whose runs share a part are one workflow, so triggers in more than one group mean the file should be split at its triggers; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: Every part is linked to a trigger
checks.about: Following lines either way from the triggers, leaving out comments and their ties, reaches every part; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: Every comment is tied to a part
checks.about: A comment explains what it is tied to, so each has a tie; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: Every step is started by a trigger
checks.about: Each step, review and standing approval is in some trigger's run, the parts its start lines reach; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: No context is written by more than one workflow
checks.about: A context that workflows given together share is written by only one of them, since each may change what another relies on; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: No connector is read by more than one workflow
checks.about: A connector that workflows given together share brings items in for only one of them, since each may take an item another expects; this warns and never fails.

checks.name: Every platform description value is of the right kind
checks.about: platform is a mapping, off_for_up_to a duration, steps code or agent, agents and calls lists of company ids, and holds a list.
checks.skippedBecause: no file given is a platform description

checks.name: Every company id and path is well written
checks.about: A platform description's id is a company id or owner/platforms/slug, its company ids are lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and what it holds are relative paths.
checks.skippedBecause: no file given is a platform description
